reason: Ember's EachView.createChildView (vendor/assets/javascripts/development/ember.js:8217-8224) writes the `member` alias into each item view's own keywords (`view._keywords[keyword] = content`). So group_member.hbs:1 can resolve `member` inside the `{{each member in members itemView="group-member"}}` rows created at group.hbs:170, and the rows and the removeMember action get the actual user.
